examples.english: We are not talking at any time about a pro-republican Charles III (of Spain), although we are talking about a monarchical reformist with a liberal vision in some political and social aspects that would allow the stability, continuity and aggrandizement of his reign.
examples.ref: 2017 December 25, Alberto Navas Blanco, “Antecedentes coloniales del voto en Venezuela”, in El Nacional:
examples.text: Sin que estemos hablando en ningún momento de un Carlos III prorrepublicano, aunque sí de un reformista monárquico con visión liberal en algunos aspectos políticos y sociales que permitiesen la estabilidad, continuidad y engrandecimiento de su reinado.
examples.translation: We are not talking at any time about a pro-republican Charles III (of Spain), although we are talking about a monarchical reformist with a liberal vision in some political and social aspects that would allow the stability, continuity and aggrandizement of his reign.
